summary: Enhance your skills with our Data Science with Python Training Course. Learn data analysis, visualization, and machine learning in a hands-on environment.
lede: Data science with Python combines data preparation, statistical analysis and machine learning to develop useful predictions from datasets. It is designed for professionals with a foundation in Python who need to build and apply analytical models, with practice in cleaning and exploring data, creating and validating machine-learning pipelines, forecasting time series, and deploying models through REST APIs.
audienceIntro: This program is tailored for professionals who have a foundational grasp of Python and wish to transition into high-impact data science and machine learning roles.
modules: Advanced Python for Data Science Foundations
Visual Storytelling and Exploratory Data Analysis
Advanced Regression and Time Series Forecasting
Natural Language Processing and Text Analytics
Neural Networks and Deep Learning Fundamentals
MLOps, Model Deployment, and Data Ethics
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational knowledge of Python programming, including variables, loops, and functions. Familiarity with basic mathematical concepts such as linear algebra, probability, and statistics is highly recommended. No prior experience with machine learning is required, but a working knowledge of data analysis in Excel or SQL is beneficial.
topics: Data science & machine learning in practice
